note: The module provides one Block plugin, configurable_views_filter_block_block, extending core ViewsExposedFilterBlock and reusing its deriver, so derivatives are keyed configurable_views_filter_block_block:<view_id>-<display_id> for displays with 'Exposed form in block' enabled. Per-instance block settings: visible_filters (list of exposed-filter identifiers kept visible) plus booleans no_groups, no_reset, no_sort, no_pager. No route/permissions/services/drush. All medium/hard cases are grounded in a real block config entity's settings. FIXTURE: setup/reset scripts raw-write the module's own bundled test view (view_simple_exposed_filters, page_1 display, exposed filters 'title' and 'uid', exposed_block=true) via config.storage->write() rather than a View entity save. This is deliberate: the shared site currently has a PRE-EXISTING, unrelated fatal (vefl_bef's exposed_form plugin is incompatible with the installed better_exposed_filters, a PHP TypeError) that aborts any views exposed_form plugin discovery/render or View entity save. Block config-entity placement and reading settings back do NOT trigger it, so introspection/verify work; the scripts were smoke-tested this way. Rendering the block or building its config form on the UI may hit that vefl_bef fatal until the site's BEF/vefl mismatch is fixed.

evals.prompt: I want to place a Views exposed-filters block but only show some of the filters, using the configurable_views_filter_block module. Which block do I place, and what must be enabled on the view display first for that block to be available?
evals.expected_output: Place the 'Views Exposed Filter Block (configurable form)' block (plugin configurable_views_filter_block_block, a derivative configurable_views_filter_block_block:<view>-<display>). It only exists for a view display that has 'Exposed form in block' enabled (display option exposed_block: true) and has exposed filters.

evals.prompt: Using configurable_views_filter_block, which per-instance block settings let me hide the reset button, hide the exposed sort, hide the exposed pager, and flatten collapsible filter groups?
evals.expected_output: The block's settings include booleans no_reset (hide reset button), no_sort (hide exposed sort_by/sort_order), no_pager (hide exposed items_per_page/offset), and no_groups (convert collapsible details groups into plain containers). Which of reset/sort/pager options appear depends on whether the view exposes them.

evals.prompt: With configurable_views_filter_block, I want one block to show only a subset of a view's exposed filters. Which block setting controls which filters are shown, and what happens to the filters I don't select (are their values lost)?
evals.expected_output: The visible_filters setting (a list of exposed-filter identifiers) controls which filters stay visible; any exposed filter not listed is hidden. Hidden filters are only visually hidden (wrapped in <div class="hidden-exposed-filter">), not removed via #access, so their submitted values are preserved. Each instance also gets a fresh unique form id so the same view's form can appear multiple times.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a configurable Views exposed-filter block placed for a view that exposes both a 'title' and a 'uid' filter. Inspect the live block configuration and state which exposed filter it is set to keep visible.
evals.expected_output: The block (cvfb_probe) has visible_filters set to just 'uid' (the title filter is hidden). Read block.block.cvfb_probe settings.visible_filters.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a configurable Views exposed-filter block. Inspect its live configuration and state which visibility options it has turned on (is the reset button hidden? is the sort hidden?).
evals.expected_output: The block (cvfb_options) has no_reset = true and no_sort = true (reset button and exposed sort hidden), while no_groups and no_pager are false. Read block.block.cvfb_options settings.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site (theme olivero) there is a view 'view_simple_exposed_filters' whose 'page_1' display has 'Exposed form in block' enabled and exposes a 'title' and a 'uid' filter. Place a Configurable Views Filter Block (block id 'cvfb_task') in the content region that shows ONLY the 'title' exposed filter. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a block config entity id cvfb_task with plugin configurable_views_filter_block_block:view_simple_exposed_filters-page_1, theme olivero, region content, and settings.visible_filters containing only 'title' (uid excluded).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a configurable Views exposed-filter block with id 'cvfb_hide'. Reconfigure it so the exposed sort controls AND the reset button are hidden on that block. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In block.block.cvfb_hide settings, set no_sort = true and no_reset = true (both), leaving the filters visible.
